description: This file defines an AuthService class responsible for managing OAuth flows and API token authentication for Atlassian products like Jira and Confluence. It includes methods to initiate OAuth, handle callbacks, exchange codes for tokens, fetch user info, and test API tokens.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service for handling Atlassian OAuth and API token authentication.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] start_oauth_flow(self, service: str)
methods.description: Initiates OAuth flow for Jira or Confluence, generating authorization URL and state.

methods.name: SessionData handle_oauth_callback(self, code: str, state: str)
methods.description: Processes OAuth callback, exchanges code for tokens, and creates session data.

methods.name: SessionData authenticate_with_api_token(self, api_token: str, email: Optional[str], domain: str, service: str)
methods.description: Authenticates using an API token or Personal Access Token, creating session data.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _exchange_code_for_tokens(self, code: str, service: str)
methods.description: Exchanges authorization code for access tokens.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_user_info(self, access_token: str)
methods.description: Retrieves user information using an access token.

methods.name: list _get_accessible_resources(self, access_token: str)
methods.description: Fetches accessible Atlassian resources for the user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _test_api_token(self, api_token: str, email: Optional[str], domain: str, service: str)
methods.description: Tests API token validity by making a test API call.
